items.summary: Rebuild the app’s information architecture and navigation to match the uploaded screenshots, including a top-level segmented navigation with three sections: “Customer View”, “Upload Section”, and “Admin Panel”, and ensure the currently selected section is visually highlighted as in the screenshots.
Add/adjust migration logic so upgrading from the current deployed canister state (which contains live events state) does not trap, and initializes the new comment-generator/admin-panel state cleanly.

Match the screenshots’ overall visual style across the rebuilt screens: soft pastel background with subtle geometric/confetti shapes, rounded cards with light borders/shadows, and primary gradient buttons (blue→teal). Apply this theme consistently across Customer View, Upload Section, and Admin Panel.

Create and use a static background asset similar to the screenshots’ pastel geometric/confetti backdrop, stored under frontend/public/assets/generated, and render it as the page background (not served from the backend).

Implement the “Customer View” screen to match the screenshots: include a “Single Comment Generator” card and a “Bulk Comment Generator” card, each requiring the user to select a “Comment List” before generating output, with mobile-first spacing, rounded cards, and gradient call-to-action buttons similar to the screenshots.

Implement the “Upload Section” screen to match the screenshot: “Upload Rating Image” card with fields for “Your Name” (text input) and “Select Image” (file picker) and an upload action that persists the uploaded image and metadata to the backend for later admin review.

Implement the “Admin Panel” screen layout to match the screenshots, including an Admin Panel header/subtitle and secondary tab navigation: “Comments”, “Images”, “Chat”, and “Settings”. Admin Panel access must remain gated by the existing URL-hash admin token mechanism (caffeineAdminToken) already implemented in the project.

Admin Panel → Comments tab: implement comment list management to match screenshots, including: (1) Create New List (list name input + “Create List” button), (2) Existing Lists selector/list with lock icons, (3) a “Managing: <ListName>” section with available/used counts, reset and delete controls, (4) comment add modes: “Bulk Upload” (textarea: one comment per line) and “Single Comment” (single input), (5) list of comments with per-comment delete actions, and (6) a “Bulk Comment Totals” summary card showing counts per list.

Admin Panel → Settings tab: implement “Bulk Generator Access Key” management as shown in the screenshots, including display of current status (“Key Set”/“Not Set”), a masked key display, a “Reset Key” action, an input to set a new access key with show/hide toggle, and an “Update Key” button. The Bulk Comment Generator on Customer View must require this access key before allowing bulk generation.

Admin Panel → Images tab: provide an admin view of uploaded rating images, including a list/grid showing uploader name, upload timestamp, and a preview thumbnail; allow admin to delete an uploaded image entry.

Admin Panel → Chat tab: implement a simple admin-manageable chat/messages view consistent with the screenshot’s tab structure, including creating new messages and displaying an ordered message list. Persist messages in the backend so refresh retains history.

Replace the current backend “live events” storage/APIs with a persistent comment-list system backing the screenshot flows: store comment lists, comments, per-comment used status, per-user usage tracking for single/bulk generation, uploaded rating images (blob + metadata), chat messages, and the bulk generator access key. Add query and update methods needed by Customer View and Admin Panel.
